questions.q: What relationship does this lesson add to complete the CSDM structure started in Lesson 23?
options: A new relationship type that replaces Runs on and Depends on
A relationship between SCHED-APP-01 and SCHED-APP-02
A relationship between the EHR platform and the load balancer
The Technical Service–to–Business Service mapping between Patient Scheduling Application Service and Patient Scheduling
questions.explain: Mapping the Technical Service up to its Business Service is what lets impact analysis walk from the business-facing record down into the real infrastructure CIs.

questions.q: Which CIs will Discovery maintain going forward, and which stay manually governed?
options: Nothing is maintained by Discovery in this capstone
Discovery maintains everything, including the Business Service mapping
Discovery maintains only the load balancer CI
Discovery maintains the infrastructure CIs (SCHED-APP-01, SCHED-APP-02, SCHED-SQL-01); the application CI and Business Service mapping stay manual
questions.explain: Discovery can identify infrastructure it scans, but it doesn't know what business service a piece of software supports — that stays governed by people.

questions.q: Why does this capstone's Discovery plan require placing a MID Server in Meridian's clinical-systems network segment?
options: MID Servers are optional and only improve scan speed
MID Servers are only needed for database CIs, not for application servers
The scheduling application requires a MID Server to run at all
Discovery needs a MID Server with real network line of sight to a host before it can scan it, per Chapter 4 Lesson 17, and the existing MID Servers can't reach that segment
questions.explain: Without a MID Server with access to that segment, Discovery has no path to SCHED-APP-01, SCHED-APP-02, or SCHED-SQL-01 at all.

questions.q: What problem do Identification Rules solve once Discovery starts scanning SCHED-APP-01, SCHED-APP-02, and SCHED-SQL-01?
options: They automatically create the Business Service mapping
They prevent Discovery from creating brand-new duplicate CI records instead of reconciling into the ones already built by hand
They remove the need for a MID Server entirely
They speed up how fast Discovery schedules run
questions.explain: Without matching identification attributes like FQDN, serial number, or instance name, Discovery has no way to recognize the existing records and creates duplicates instead.

questions.q: Which four CMDB Health Dashboard metrics does this lesson check the build against?
options: Completeness, correctness, compliance, and currency
Ownership, ticket volume, change frequency, and incident count
Uptime, latency, throughput, and error rate
Cost, licensing, vendor support, and warranty status
questions.explain: These are the four CMDB Health Dashboard metrics from Chapter 5 Lesson 18 this lesson applies: required attributes filled, zero duplicates, expected relationships present, and recent Discovery timestamps.
